rules.title: How to play
rules.subtitle: Those are the main rules:
bullets: Swipe left to skip and add 1 point; swipe right to check for a match (match resets to 0).
Every 10 left swipes the counter glows and confetti celebrates milestones.
Sprint mode: tap the 60s sprint to race for points; the timer ends automatically.
Notifications: allow reminders that follow the day's heat (softer by day, warmer at night); there's also a quick test mode that fires about every 30s.
Loving messages: every 15 left swipes outside sprint, a love note pops up; cards stay infinite and fully local.
